# sendgrid_ip_pool (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid IP pool by name, including its assigned IPs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_ip_pool" "marketing" {
  name = "marketing"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The pool's name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The pool's name (identical to `name`).
- `ips` (Set of String) The IP addresses assigned to this pool.
